description: Parked in the grounds of the heritage mansion and converted into the MosPhil by RRR cocktail bar and lounge, which opened in 2022. Ex-Mosphil Aero, a short-lived Philippine domestic operator of the mid-2000s.
Second airframe in the grounds, ex-Cebu Pacific Air. Photographed in place in 2021-2022; not yet fitted out for public entry at that time.
